Section A, new, from the Horizon recipe. Horizon, with orbits on the downbeat. The cosmos: the camera flies with the track, drawn in by builds and let go on drops, each section on the galaxy arm that suits it. The glow flies behind the planets. A star flashes on each downbeat. Changes fade in. Colours: one hue against two. Pace: driving, pulsing on every beat.
